title: Injector Service State
description: Injects a configured static value into the pipeline, replacing or providing the current data. (Runtimes: browser, cpp, node; IDs: hookup.to/service/injector, injector)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

inject.description: Value to store and emit. Setting this fires an immediate app.next()

injectBinary.description: hkp-rt and hkp-node only: base64 payload to store and emit as binary

recentInjection.description: Restore the last injected value on board load (set automatically)

plainText.description: Treat the stored value as a plain string rather than parsed JSON
